basic_profile.bio: I'm a newcomer to the online chess community, drawn to the intriguing complexity of chess variants. Originally from Chicago, I work as a software developer in a mid-sized tech firm. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring digital tools and apps, like Rocketbook, and have recently become a parent, diving deep into BabyLedWeaning. My partner and I are avid board game enthusiasts. I'm typically online during late evenings, after putting our little one to bed.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of chess and its common variants. My knowledge stems from casual online play and reading forums. As a software developer, I also have a knack for learning new things quickly, especially when they involve logical and strategic thinking.
